Implementation: Single `index.html` + bundled JS. Data baked into `graph_data.json`.
215 papers fetched live from arXiv (BCI, EEG decoding, connectomics, neural security, deep learning, clinical).
Every title, author, abstract, year, and URL is from arXiv API.
700 keyword co-occurrence edges (≥2 shared terms). Honest `data-completeness` badge states arXiv has no citation API, so this is the permitted fallback.
`react-force-graph-3d` + Three.js. Orbit/zoom/pan. No 2D canvas fallback.
Procedural radial gradient on canvas, `AdditiveBlending`, `depthWrite: false`.
Louvain greedy modularity → merged into ~8 semantic clusters (ruby, sapphire, emerald, amethyst, topaz, carnelian, turquoise, violet).
`#C8A951` at opacity 0.05 (0.015 when dimmed). Never forms a dense web.
Post-processing bloom (strength 1.5, radius 0.4, threshold 0.85) + 6,000 additive white particles.
Fixed `fx/fy/fz` positions. Rejection sampling with `MIN_DIST = 8`. No force simulation = no "hairball".
Sorted by co-occurrence weight, capped at 700.
Zoom from z=800 → 320 over frames + `autoRotateSpeed: 0.6`.
Canvas wheel listener with `{passive: false}` + `preventDefault()`. Page never scrolls.
Hover dims non-community nodes to opacity 0.12. Click toggles persistent filter.
Highlights neighbors (opacity 0.65) + opens right detail card with full abstract + "Open paper ↗" arXiv link.
ZIP export (CSV + README) via JSZip + file-saver.
Catches runtime errors, shows reloadable error screen. No white screen.
All `useState/useEffect/useMemo/useCallback` called before any early return.
`getFirstAuthor()` handles `string`, `string[]`, missing, comma-separated.
Detail card shrinks on mobile; legend stays usable.
